mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates ultra-accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and boosting equity valuations, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.25%.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate below 9.5% signals strengthening labor market conditions, improving corporate profit visibility and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: When UNRATE falls below 9.5%, the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of such instances.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand, accelerating economic expansion and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 90.0 signals economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during recession risk phases.
failure_condition: In the recession risk phase (defined by INDPRO < 90.0), the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDP (GDPC1) signals economic expansion, boosting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of quarters when GDPC1 shows a quarterly increase.

mechanism_narrative: CPI inflation exceeding 2.5% annualized signals persistent inflation, prompting anticipated monetary tightening and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: When CPIAUCSL annualized inflation exceeds 2.5%, the 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and fall in unemployment (UNRATE) indicates labor market strength, improving consumer spending and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising PAYEMS and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in housing starts (HOUST) during housing market recovery signals strong consumer confidence, accelerating economic activity and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In the housing market recovery phase (defined by HOUST rising above its 12-month moving average), the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of cases.
